additional_info.subject: Re: ID0390634-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / S7 170003841] Outlet1 toggling between available & unavailable CRM:00921001295
additional_info.body:
Hello Jessica,
Thanks for the response.
We checked the logs and found that the PLC is not reachable to SECC. Additionally, we found the following error in the logs, indicating that the issue may be with EcoG (KF12).
2024-11-19T04:49:53.897632+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/aea4193aa213[677]: PLC-Error-Flag 'SECC_DC1_MB_Problem_KF12' changed to true - (loss of communication DC1 and SECC)
Check if the communication is established correctly and the SECC is correctly working.
On-Site:
Check if the Ethernet cable is properly attached to the switch. It come from +F03-KF12 (J10) output through WD5 cable and it reaches the +F03-XF1:P5
If we cannot check the connectivity, we can test replacing the Ethernet cable.
If it doesn't work then try replacing the KF12 and see if it works.
Check if the 24V are being applied correctly to KF12 coming from the +F03-XD3:18C to the VDC input of the KF12
If there are no 24V being applied to KF12, please check if the XD3 connector is correctly fitted and there are no loose connections
Otherwise please check if FC15 is tripped and having 24V output.
If you need any further assistance, please do notify us.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
